label: KarooFireFly
description:
Automatic smart bike light control based on time of day and ambient light. Supports ANT+ lights (via Karoo pairing) and Magicshine BLE lights (via Bluetooth). Per-light configuration with protocol-specific modes, time-based and ambient light sensor automation, zone change notifications, and manual override via BonusActions.

![Connected Lights](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/derstrassi/karoofirefly/main/docs/settings_lights.png)
![Light Detail](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/derstrassi/karoofirefly/main/docs/settings_dialog.png)
![Time-based](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/derstrassi/karoofirefly/main/docs/settings_timebased.png)
releaseNotes:
* Magicshine BLE light support (Hori 1300, EVO 1700)
* Per-light profiles with protocol-specific modes
* Tap-to-configure light detail dialog with test buttons
* Battery and temperature readout for BLE lights
* Live ANT+ connection status
* Auto-off on pause option
* Zone change notifications with per-light mode details
* Protocol badges (ANT+/BLE) and connection status indicators
* Delete light configuration with confirmation
